### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now (after one store-side recording). Set dd495945: 65K, 4 x $228.00, bank card, T-16034418, purchased 2026-09-08, installed 2026-09-09 @33120, active. Days kept 2026-09-09 -> 2026-10-14 = 35 <= 45 trial days. Miles since install at reported odometer 35612 = 2492 <= 3,000 trial miles.
